buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SITC of two (2) Nos. 630 kVA CPCB IV+ compliant diesel generating sets with acoustic e nclosures, up gradation of the synchronizing panel controllers, and associated electric al and civil works, under buy-back of the four (4) existing DG sets (2 x 600 kVA and 2 x 320 kVA), with two (2) years comprehensive on-site warranty followed by three (3) yea rs comprehensive AMC (CAMC), at INCOIS, Hyderabad Delivery/ Completion Period: Supply of the DG sets, ACB panels and controllers within 8 weeks, civil works within 8 weeks, and commissioning within 14 weeks, from the date of the GeM contract , followed by the 30-day reliability run (Clause 8.4).

Warranty Period: two (2) years comprehensive on-site warranty from the date of the commissio ning certificate, followed by three (3) years comprehensive on-site AMC (CAMC), as per Section 9. Payment terms: a) Items A1, B2 and B3: 70% shall be paid within 30 days of the supply of the items at INCOIS . Item B1 (installation, testing and commissioning): 70% shall be paid within 30 days of the completion of erection, cabling and the controller retrofit, as certified by the Engineer-in-C harge. Payment is subject to the receipt inspection report, FAT report, CPCB IV+ type-appr oval and COP certificates, the original ink-signed invoice and the warranty undertaking; the Performance Security (Sl. 7) shall be in place. b) A further 20% of Items A1 and B1 to B3 shall be released within 30 days of successful insta llation, testing and commissioning. Release is subject to the commissioning certificate (Cla use 8.2), the handover documents (Clause 8.5) and the Engineer-in-Charge's certificate. Ite m E1: 90% shall be paid with this payment. c) Items C1 to C12 (civil works): 90% of the value of the work done, at jointly measured quan tities, shall be paid on a pro-rata basis in not more than two (2) running account (RA) bills, t he second on completion of the civil works. d) The balance 10% of Items A1, B1 to B3, C1 to C12 and E1 shall be released within 30 days of the completion of the two(2) year warranty period, less any recoveries under Clause 9.5. e) Items D1 to D3 (CAMC, years 3 to 5): the rate for each year will be paid in four equal quart erly instalments, in arrears, after the completion of each quarter, within 30 days of validati ng the quarterly service report, breakdown logs and response times under Clause 9.5, less recoveries. No separate payment is made for the two-year warranty; its cost is included in I tems A1 and B1. f) For measured items, payment will be as per actual measurement. Net payment will be released after statutory deductions. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.
